where: Shangri-La (Zhongdian), Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, northwest Yunnan, China, 3,200 m on the edge of the Tibetan plateau
season: Early October on the Tibetan plateau: Napa Lake full after the summer rains, the wide grassland turning golden-brown, dark conifer forest on the surrounding hills, deep-blue high-altitude sky with a few small white clouds, crisp clear air

shots.label: hook
shots.view: Napa Lake (Napahai): a calm wide lake with the forested hills and distant mountain ridges mirrored perfectly in the water, golden-brown grassland along the shore, small white clouds reflected
shots.action: She stands still at the water's edge seen from close behind her right shoulder, a light breeze lifting her braids and the white fur trim of her red robe, looking out over the lake.
shots.move: Start close behind her shoulder, then glide very slowly backwards and up at one gentle constant speed to reveal the whole lake and its mirrored mountains; she stays in the lower third.

shots.view: the grassy shore of Napa Lake, shallow clear water with reeds, the lake and hills stretching behind
shots.action: She walks slowly along the shore from left to right, looking out over the water.
shots.move: Very slow, gimbal-smooth side tracking shot at her slow walking pace, keeping her medium-wide on the left third with the lake filling the frame.

shots.view: the vast Napa grassland: golden-brown meadow reaching to the forested hills, a small herd of black and white yaks grazing far away, mountain ridges under a deep-blue sky
shots.move: Locked-off tripod shot at eye level, the camera perfectly still; only the grass sways and the yaks graze. The nearest grass is a few metres away, no close foreground.
shots.ambience: wind over the grass, a distant yak bell

shots.view: close detail of wild golden meadow grass (thin wild grass stems and feathery seed heads, not wheat or barley) on the Napa grassland, the soft blurred lake and hills behind
shots.move: Locked, low camera at grass height; only the grass moves, swaying in waves in the wind.

shots.view: Ganden Sumtseling Monastery (Songzanlin), the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Yunnan: white-walled monk quarters climbing a hillside to the great assembly halls on top with gilded golden roofs, red and white Tibetan walls, the small Lapa Lake in front reflecting it
shots.move: Majestic wide establishing shot from across Lapa Lake, very slow push-in at one constant speed.
shots.ambience: breeze, distant birds, faint wind chimes

shots.view: the wide stone visitor stairway leading up to the golden-roofed main assembly hall of Songzanlin Monastery, white and red walls on both sides
shots.action: She walks calmly up the stone steps, then pauses and looks up at the golden roofs, admiring them. Seen from behind and slightly to the side.
shots.move: Slow follow from behind at a respectful distance, the monastery filling the upper frame.
shots.ambience: footsteps on stone, breeze, faint chimes

shots.view: a cobbled street of Dukezong Ancient Town: two-storey traditional Tibetan wooden houses with dark timber facades, carved and painted window frames, prayer flags strung above, warm shop windows
shots.action: She walks slowly along the cobbled street, glancing at the carved facades.
shots.move: Very slow, gimbal-smooth tracking shot gliding backwards ahead of her at her slow walking pace; she is medium-wide, the street and facades fill the frame.
shots.ambience: footsteps on cobbles, distant town murmur

shots.view: close detail of an old carved and painted wooden door in Dukezong, warm light glowing from the shop window beside it
shots.move: Locked-off shot square to the door, a barely perceptible slow push-in; no sideways move.

shots.view: a worn wooden table by the window of a small teahouse in Dukezong, a simple white porcelain tea cup on it
shots.action: Tight close-up on the table: her two hands (five fingers each, the colourful striped cuffs of her red robe folded back, white fur trim) wrap around the warm tea cup; thin wisps of steam rise slowly from the tea and curl in the window light. The frame shows only the table, the cup, the steam and her hands and wrists: the top edge of the frame stays below her chest for the whole clip, her face, hair and shoulders never appear.
shots.move: Locked close-up, the camera does not move, tilt or pull back; only the steam and a slight shift of her fingers move.
shots.ambience: soft cup on wood, distant street

shots.view: the window seat of a small wooden teahouse in Dukezong, the old cobbled street visible outside in warm late-afternoon light
shots.action: She sits by the window holding the tea cup in both hands, quietly watching people pass in the street, calm, relaxed.
shots.move: Locked medium-wide shot from inside the teahouse, very slight slow push-in.

shots.view: elevated view from Guishan Park hill over the rooftops of Dukezong Ancient Town at sunset: dark wooden Tibetan roofs, the warm window lights and street lanterns starting to glow, the giant golden prayer wheel on the hill catching the last light, mountains under a pastel peach and pink sky
shots.move: Locked-off wide from the hilltop with a very slow straight push-in toward the town; no pan.

shots.view: Guishan Park hill above Dukezong at sunset, the old town's glowing rooftops spread below
shots.action: She stands at the railing seen from behind, nothing on her back (no backpack, no bag), looking out over the rooftops, the breeze moving her hair. Still and calm.
shots.move: Very slow push-in from behind her over her shoulder toward the glowing town.
shots.ambience: evening breeze, faint prayer flags flapping

shots.view: the whole of Dukezong Ancient Town in bright early dusk seen from Guishan hill: hundreds of warm lights glowing in the wooden houses and streets, the illuminated golden prayer wheel in the foreground, soft mountains against a luminous pastel pink and pale-blue sky
shots.move: Lingering wide shot with a very slow pull-back, almost still.
